name: approve_action
description: Carry out a drafted action (send the email or message, cancel or block the subscription) and save a dated report. Only call this after you have read the draft summary aloud and the user has clearly said yes in this turn. Never call it on silence, a maybe, or a question.

action_id.description: The id of the pending action, exactly as returned by propose_action (the 'id' field).
